title: San Francisco Taiwanese Association 北加州 舊金山台灣同鄉會
content_html: The San Francisco Taiwanese Association (舊金山台灣同鄉會) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations in the United States. The chapter serves the Taiwanese American community in the San Francisco area and is listed under the TAA Western region (美西).
